# bcaquiferdata

This is an R package for processing BC Gov GWELLS data into formats more
suitable for other analyses (e.g., Strater, Voxler, ArcHydro).

The functions provided here allow users to filter GWELLS data by region
(shapefile), calculate and add elevation data from Lidar or TRIM, and
clean and categorize GWELLS lithology and yield data.

The Shiny app (a graphical user interface), provides a tool for data
exploration and exporting.

We’re still actively refining and adding to this tool, but it is
maturing. See the [bcaquiferdata
website](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata) for tutorials and
documentation.

## Quick Start

- Install/Update [**R**](https://cloud.r-project.org/) and
  [**RStudio**](https://rstudio.com/)
- Install pak - `install.packages("pak", dependencies = TRUE)`
- Install bcaquiferdata - `pak::pkg_install("bcgov/bcaquiferdata")`
  \[Update All if asked\]
- Launch the Shiny App -
  [`aq_app()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/aq_app.md)

## In Detail

1.  [**Install/Update RStudio**](https://rstudio.com/) (if it’s been a
    while)

2.  [**Install/Update R**](https://cloud.r-project.org/) (if it’s been a
    while)

3.  **Open RStudio**

4.  **Install pak** In the console type the following and hit enter

    ``` r
    install.packages("pak", dependencies = TRUE)
    ```

5.  **Check that your system is ready** Install build tools if prompted

    ``` r
    pkgbuild::check_build_tools()
    ```

6.  **Install bcaquiferdata** In the console type the following and hit
    enter (be sure to install all updates if prompted!)

    ``` r
    pak::pkg_install("bcgov/bcaquiferdata")
    ```

## Development version

If you’re interested in testing out the developmental version of the
package, you can install it with

``` r
pak::pkg_install("bcgov/bcaquiferdata@dev")
```

## Troubleshooting

If you run into errors right at the start, try **updating all packages
required by bcaquiferdata**

``` r
pak::pkg_install("bcgov/bcaquiferdata", upgrade = TRUE)
```

## Shiny User-Interface

To lauch the Shiny User-Interface, type this line into the R console at
the prompt (in the screen with `>`) and hit ‘Enter’.

``` r
bcaquiferdata::aq_app() # Launch the app
```

**See the
[tutorial](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/articles/bcaquiferdata.html)
for a more in-depth look at how to use the User Interface**

# Package index

## Shiny App

- [`aq_app()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/aq_app.md)
  : Launch Aquifer Data Shiny App

## Dealing with Data

Download and manage data

- [`data_read()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/data_read.md)
  : Download, Update, and/or load data
- [`data_update()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/data_update.md)
  : Update cached data
- [`cache_clean()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/cache_clean.md)
  : Clean cache

## Workflow

Processing data

- [`dem_region()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/dem_region.md)
  : Fetch and trim DEM of a region
- [`wells_eg_fixed`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_eg_fixed.md)
  : wells_eg_fixed
- [`wells_eg_unfixed`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_eg_unfixed.md)
  : wells_eg_unfixed
- [`wells_elev()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_elev.md)
  : Subset wells and add elevation
- [`wells_export()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_export.md)
  : Export wells data for use in Strater and Voxler
- [`wells_subset()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_subset.md)
  : Subset wells to region
- [`wells_yield()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/wells_yield.md)
  : Add yield lithology data to wells subset

## Helper Functions

Functions you may not need, but might use for troubleshooting

- [`lith_fix()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/lith_fix.md)
  : Fix lithology descriptions
- [`fix_depth_mismatch()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/fix_depth_mismatch.md)
  : Fix the depth of the well if not equal to final lithology
- [`fix_yield_zero()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/fix_yield_zero.md)
  : Fix the yield of a well if equal to zero

## Drawdown

Creating Excel Drawdown Worksheets

- [`drawdown()`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/drawdown.md)
  : Create Excel Drawdown template file

## Data

- [`tiles`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/tiles.md)
  : tiles
- [`flags`](https://bcgov.github.io/bcaquiferdata/dev/reference/flags.md)
  : Flags
